## Description
- A PR template and self-review checklist committed 
## What changed 
- add new repo.
- Write a PR template a reviewer would actually find useful
- Write my personal pre-PR self-review checklist

- Add a “How to run” section

## Why is this change required?

- Building a documentation system within your project ensures the quality of teamwork, by creating a unified pull request template (PR Template) and a self-review checklist.

## How to test
1. Activate the environment
2. Run the script
3. Verify the output

## PR Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the style guidelines of this project
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code
- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas
- [ ] I have updated the README.md with relevant instructions
- [ ] My changes generate no new warnings or errors
